title: Cross-court forehand rally
setup: Two players, one each side of the net, both starting on the deuce side behind the baseline. Hoop targets mark the deep cross-court zone on each side.
instructions: Aim deep past the service line into the hoop zone. Count consecutive balls.
Switch to the ad side (backhands) after five minutes.

title: Fed backhand, rotate through the queue
setup: Coach at the net in the centre with a basket. Hitter starts on the ad side behind the baseline. The other three players queue behind the baseline, outside the doubles sideline.
instructions: Coach feeds one ball to the backhand.
Hitter drives it cross-court, then jogs round to the back of the queue.
Next player steps in straight away. Keep the queue moving.

title: Wide forehand: move, hit, recover
setup: Feeder on the deuce side between the net and the service line, basket beside them. Hitter starts on the centre mark. The feed and the run happen together (step 1), then the shot (step 2), then the recovery (step 3). A cone sits wide on each side just inside the singles sideline, and a throwdown line on the centre mark is the recovery point.
instructions: Feeder tosses wide to the forehand cone.
Hitter runs to the cone, hits cross-court over the net, and recovers to the throwdown line.
